meta.title: Regretting every line on a new draft withdraws an already-submitted bid
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation or allowed request path for regretting every line, so the regret step is omitted.
The vocabulary cannot verify that the old bid became revised, that the new bid was activated before becoming revised, or that the vendor ended with no live bid.
The vocabulary does not expose an assertion for the HTTP 200 response of the submit act.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (lock_quote_after_submission is off and no price-change approval applies) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug
warnings: verify 1: read_bid's reply shape has not been sampled; "status" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 95.
The invited QA vendor submits the bid.
As the buyer, read the bid and check that Data check: “status” equals revised.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals revised.
